name: dansolombrino-skills
description: Personal skills: an always-on core (progress updates, project categories, a web service hub, a shared-GPU niceness counter) and opt-in domain plugins such as research (reproducible GPU experiments across verified rigs).

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Always-on working discipline for every project: report status and ETA for long-running tasks when they finish, fail, or stall, and tag each project with its categories so domain plugins such as research load only where they belong, put every web service a machine hosts behind one token-gated entry point, and keep a shareable per-user GPU niceness counter for the shared behemoth box.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Materialize reproducible experiments across verified GPU rigs: scaffold projects, provision exact environments, deploy tested revisions, dispatch GPU waves as a self-balancing pull queue, supervise them from the hub without an open chat, keep a fleet-wide GPU lane board, and visualize results.
